description: This file implements PEM (Privacy-Enhanced Mail) encoding and decoding functions, including a PEMTokenizer class for parsing PEM blocks and a PEMEncode function for encoding data into PEM format. It is part of the net:: namespace and references base utility functions.

classes.name: PEMTokenizer
classes.description: A class for parsing PEM encoded blocks from a string, supporting multiple block types.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::PEMTokenizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tokenizer with a string and allowed block types.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::GetNext
methods.description: Parses and retrieves the next PEM block if available.

methods.name: PEMTokenizer::Init
methods.description: Initializes the tokenizer with the input string and allowed block types.
